_README.description: Default panel of the cli_consensus tool: the ONE place that names each backend's default model.
_README.override: Point CLI_CONSENSUS_PANEL_CONFIG_PATH at another file with the same shape.
_README.pinned_versions: codex, agy and minimax carry a fixed model version here and need updating when a model is retired. claude uses the CLI's floating alias 'opus'.
_README.per_call_override: The 'model' field of a backend spec in a cli_consensus call wins over this file for that call.
